property: Kernel-resident destination-keyed TCP memory becomes operator-visible and administrable through a Generic Netlink family and the iproute2 `ip tcp_metrics` show/delete/flush interface.

date_or_range.notes: Kernel Generic Netlink support and userspace administration belong to the same operational generation.

negative_claims: `ip tcp_metrics` does not show live socket state in the same sense as `ss -ti`/TCP_INFO.
Deleting a metrics entry does not delete a route or terminate a TCP connection.
open_questions: Recover the exact first iproute2 release containing the tcp_metrics command.
